title: Pipeline preloading does not cover necessary permutations when using XR with Forward+ renderer causing long frame stalls
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.1

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.mrlink5.mono (ddcdf9965) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900K (32 threads) - 127.7 GiB memory

### Issue description

My product allows users to select and view models at runtime in XR. We are seeing very long frame stalls (which are extra bad in XR) when trying to render these models on the first frame that they become visible. I traced through the cause and it is because neither the specialized nor uber pipelines are ready for rendering. For reasons I haven't chased down, D3D12 can sometimes take up to 0.5s for CreatePipelineState to complete.

Now these stalls are technically by design if they aren't ready, but I found that the system in Godot to preload/prebuild pipelines at mesh time (gated in the engine code by the PRELOAD_PIPELINES_ON_SURFACE_CACHE_CONSTRUCTION macro) is not handling the permutations necessary for XR/multiview rendering. I think the Mobile renderer handles this correctly, but Forward+ does not. There are two gaps here:
1. It prebuilds for PIPELINE_VERSION_DEPTH_PASS_WITH_NORMAL_AND_ROUGHNESS and PIPELINE_VERSION_DEPTH_PASS_WITH_NORMAL_AND_ROUGHNESS_AND_VOXEL_GI but not their multiview variables PIPELINE_VERSION_DEPTH_PASS_WITH_NORMAL_AND_ROUGHNESS**_MULTIVIEW** and PIPELINE_VERSION_DEPTH_PASS_WITH_NORMAL_AND_ROUGHNESS_AND_VOXEL_GI**_MULTIVIEW**. I think these need to be created when `multiview_enabled` is true. This is in `RenderForwardClustered::_mesh_compile_pipelines_for_surface()`.
2. It is prebuilding for depth format based on `RenderSceneBuffersRD::get_depth_format(false, multisampling, p_can_be_storage);` but this does not actually match the format in a more complicated combination of factors. When XR is used with Forward+ and depth submission is enabled with MSAA off (that's a mouthful!), Godot will render directly into the XR color/depth textures which almost certainly do NOT match the format get_depth_format returns. When MSAA is enabled, Godot is rendering to its internal textures and later resolves into the XR texture, and then get_depth_format is correct.

So after all of this, I don't think fixing this actually helps my product's needs because we are loading models from users and can't know what pipelines to prebuild, but I felt it was worth opening the issue since the stalls are quite bad in XR.

In fact, the stalls are EXTRA bad when there prebuilding pipelines misses a necessary permutation because the render thread will serialize `get_pipeline` calls that wait for the pipeline. So if 4 pipelines need to be created for a new frame, the render thread creates them one at a time synchronously. If the prebuilding at least kicked off the prebuilding for the right permutations, then at least they could all be built in parallel. As a consequence, we sometimes see 500ms * 4 pipeline = 2 second stalls on a single frame render when first rendering a new model.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Build an XR project using Forward+. Enable depth submission / keep MSAA off to ensure the PRELOAD_PIPELINES_ON_SURFACE_CACHE_CONSTRUCTION  feature doesn't work correctly.
2. Load a model on a background thread
3. When loading is done, switch back to the main thread and insert it into the scene so that it is visible
4. Observe that the next frame stalls.
